text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the Mega Fan Fest rolls around, Symboli Rudolf leads the event with her usual self-confidence, but her performance is marred by uncharacteristic oversights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she doesn't let that faze her as she takes her place in the exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Symboli Rudolf steps up to the starting line, the crowd gets ready for a race worthy of the Emperor—but her showing falls far short of their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For a long time after, the stands are filled with muttering about her lackluster performance.
